content: Yesu nǝ vizhvizha uuffa inabi
Kaiy nǝ gyigyiya uuffa inabi, Daadar dlaɓa iin dadda uusǝga.
Aanji kwar kǝ dǝv uuf tǝ kai kwa maay yaa zǝr biya, ghudarsa. Aanji kwar kǝ dǝva uuf kwa yaayig kǝ zǝra gwiya ɓadlav kiyavva gwiya yigaan kǝ zǝr baɗyaka.
Aanji bandakwan am ba cǝwaɗaɗa kwakyarvad ǝlbǝgǝn tagaankurda naina.

Ndzamandzǝg ma kaiya, kai dlaɓa ma kurama. Bandkwa yiga bi nǝ dǝva uufa inabi kǝ zǝr dǝ ghǝran biya, bamma ndzǝga tǝ uuffa inabi, ghǝravaru ndakwi bandkwah am yiga bi kǝ zǝr biya, ba mam ndzǝga tǝ kaiya.
Kai ǝn uuffa inabi, kuram nǝ dǝvvahana. Daddakwa ndzǝga ma kaiya, kai dlaɓa ma iina, iin wa da ya zǝr baɗyaka. Aɗaba mam maay ǝmtaɗ dǝ kai biya, am ɓaga bi aanji ndau biya.
Baɗǝm daddakwa ndza bi ma kaiy biya, band dǝva uuf kwa ɓǝlavdan ghulal, hulfakwah kǝ dǝva uufa dzaavanta ɗiivǝdǝm damma kaara, dlaɓa zuu.
Ma ndzamandzǝg ma kaiya, ǝlbǝgar dlaɓa ndzandzǝg ma kurama, am da ghalǝgaan baɗǝm kǝ dǝgit am naag nǝ uurama, am da tlǝkǝnatlǝga.
Ndzamandzǝg dǝ hǝnkala marawa kwada mardamarǝg taakiya kuram am mbǝrzahaara, band uuff kwa ya zarh marawa, aɗaba kwannahaan wa fǝgaara Daadara.
Bandkwa waiyakut nǝ Daada, ǝn waiykur band kwah dlaɓa naiya. Ndzamandzǝg ma waiyavǝr bandkwa marankur da naiya.
Kaiya fanaarafǝg kǝ adzahadzaha Daadara, dlaɓa ǝn ndzǝga ma waiyavaana. Bandkwah dlaɓa, akwamamam fǝgaarafǝg kǝ adzahadzara am ndzǝga ma waiyavara.
“Tagkurdatag kǝ kwanna kwakyarvad dlaig ǝrviɗmahuɗara aa ndzandzǝg ma kurama, dlaiga ǝrivɗmahuɗaru dlaɓa aandz ba righǝgharighana.
Kwanǝn iin na adzahadzahara, waiyamwaiyig kǝ zaraabahagh band kwa waiyankurǝt naiya.
Maay nǝ waiyavi jujig kǝ kwanǝn biya, taaki uuda vǝllada kǝ shiifǝgaan kwakyarvad tsaghwaana.
Am tsaghwahahara akwama ɓagaan kǝ dǝgit tag naiya taakiya ɓagamɓaga.
Ən madlaiy gwiiya ɗakurɗag dǝ kwatanah biya, aɗaba kwatǝnaha sǝrǝgai kǝ dǝgiti ɓag nǝ daada biya. Dlakulǝva kwaha ǝn ɗakur dǝ tsaghwahaha aɗaba tagaankurtag kǝ dǝgiti cinngana naiy baɗǝm vak Daadara.
Kurambi wa kǝssamkwakǝssǝg biya, kai wa kǝssankuraakǝsǝga ǝn fankura kǝ dagal da yaa zǝr maraw kwa da zǝlmazǝlmǝga. Tǝhala kwaha da vǝllǝkurvǝllǝg Daad kǝ dǝgiti am ghalga nǝ uuram ma ɗagaan baɗǝmma.
Kwanna iin nǝ adzhadzahara waiyamwaig kǝ zaraabaha.
Duni naa bi kǝ mbǝrzah biya
“Akwama ɗuwakursɗuug duniya, sǝramasǝrǝg taakiya ɗuwakwi kaiya lauti ɗuwa kurama.
Akwamamma dǝga Duniya, duni ma waigaan kǝ dǝgaana, aɗaba am dǝga duni biya, dlaɓa kǝsankurakakǝsǝg ma duniya, iin wa nǝ iin ɗuuwakursɗug duniya.

Dzamamdzamǝg kǝ ǝlbǝgahi tangankur naiya, ‘Kwatǝnah jigu bi kǝ dadda hǝnnyahaan biya.’ Akwama mbarkwambǝga, kuram ndakwi arda mbkurmbǝga. Akwama faraarafǝg kǝ tsagaanara, ar da fǝgaarafǝg kǝ ǝlbǝgaru dlaɓa.
Ar da ɓagkurɓag kǝ kwanahaana kǝ dǝgit baɗǝmma kwakyarvad ɗaagara, aɗaba ar sǝrǝga bi kǝ dadakwa ɓǝlakwadiɓǝlǝg biya.
Akwama ndza sanhi bi ǝn tagtǝr kǝ ǝlbǝg biya, maraa ndzaa maay dǝ haip biya. Amaa ndakwanna, am maay dǝ ɗuula kyavaɗǝgv tǝghǝr kǝ haipahaatǝr biya.
Daddakwa ɗuwakwiɗuuga ɗuugharsɗug kǝ baz Daadara.

Bagannaɓag kǝ tlǝrah baɗyak ma iitǝra maay daddakwa tapghanitapǝg kǝ ɓagaan biya. Akwama ndza ɓaganna bi kǝ tlǝrahaan biya, maraa ndza maay dǝ haip biya. Ndakwanna nǝghǝghaaranǝghǝg kǝ dǝgit ǝn ɓaga naiya, bakǝva kwaha ɗuuwarkwiɗuga, dlaɓa ɗuuranɗug kǝ Daadara.
Dzǝghardzǝg wanǝn kwakyarvad righǝvant nǝ ǝlbǝgǝn viindavan ma adzahadzah taakiya, ɗuuwarkwiɗug bagyaana.
Mada sǝghawisǝg nǝ dadda mǝlkurmǝlǝga kwan da mǝllǝg naiya davakruwa vak daada, shǝɗkwa jiira, kwa sagal vak daada iin wa da ɓa shiid tǝghǝr kǝskaiya.
Kuram ndakwi am shiidaha, aɗaba bama daa zǝnngwa am ǝmǝtaɗ dǝ kaiya.
